methods.label: Common denominator
methods.levelReason: Converting to a common denominator is Grade 5 work; the subsequent same-denominator addition is introduced in Grade 3.

candidate.annotationRationale:
The question targets unlike-denominator fraction addition (cnm_p173). The written method converts halves to quarters (cnm_p172) and adds equal-denominator fractions (cnm_p080). The basic property of fractions (cnm_p167) supports the conversion, while fraction meaning (cnm_p165) supplies the underlying unit interpretation.
